title: Hydraulic Envelope and Representation Geometry Qualification
objective: Determine whether the qualified F-LMFP08 homogeneous-face representation can be extended to a materially broader hydraulic envelope with a coordinate system regular through h=0, fail-closed boundaries, bounded table cardinality and qualified heterogeneous-interface continuity, without changing production code or weakening mass and reference gates.

staged_gates.B_homogeneous_face_matrix: rerun F-LMFP08 identities and Darcian face-oracle matrix over expanded head envelope, materials and face lengths, with MFP and Darcian-ratio table densities treated separately
staged_gates.C_heterogeneous_interface: qualify equal-flux interface continuity, accuracy and bounded local solve behaviour over material contrasts
staged_gates.D_cardinality_and_cost: measure material/geometry-class counts, table memory and preparation/runtime cost proxies
staged_gates.E_transient_regression: rerun F-LMFP07/F-LMFP08 ordinary and strong-gradient transient gates with exact mass conservation

A1.head: cfe57ba6ff00a177832113b146bf76d2e7275e8d
A1.interpretation: Coordinate family was regular through h=0 but density was insufficient over eight decades of dry-head range. Thresholds were retained unchanged.

memory_interpretation.mfp_phi_table: 1D immutable data shared per hydraulic material; 128 head nodes do not imply a geometry-specific 128x27 table
memory_interpretation.required_next_test: Gate B must separately qualify a coarser asinh head axis for the geometry-specific Darcian log-ratio table while using the 128-node material MFP table as baseline.

candidate_questions: How coarse can the geometry-specific Darcian-ratio head axis remain while preserving the F-LMFP08 face and transient gains on the expanded head envelope?
Can saturated and near-saturated Darcian-ratio behaviour be represented continuously without a special discontinuous branch?
Can the correction be normalized so face-length cardinality is smaller than one table per exact face distance?
Does the heterogeneous equal-flux interface remain continuous and accurate when either half-face crosses the near-saturated region?
Which parts of the extremely dry tail should be represented versus fail closed based on physically negligible conductance?
